info.title: Kentik V5 API (query and batch)
info.description: Hand-maintained description of the Kentik V5 endpoints that have no V6 equivalent. Sources: the Kentik Knowledge Base Query API and Customization API pages, the V5 SDK (kentik-api 1.x), and a live check on 2026-10-16. Paths are relative to the V5 base URL: https://api.kentik.com/api/v5 (US) or https://api.kentik.eu/api/v5 (EU). V5 sends no rate limit headers.

post.description: Runs one or more queries on the Kentik Data Engine and returns the result rows of each bucket, with time series for the top-X rows.

200.description: The result rows of each bucket.

400.description: The request is not valid, for example a query without device_name.

401.description: The credentials are missing or wrong.

403.description: The user may not call this endpoint.

429.description: The rate limit is exceeded. V5 sends no rate limit headers.

post.description: Runs one or more queries and returns a chart image as a base64 data URI. Not verified: in a live check on 2026-10-16 this endpoint gave no response within 180 seconds. Decode the result with kentik_api.v5_tools.decode_chart().

200.description: The chart image as a data URI.

400.description: The request is not valid, for example a query without device_name.

401.description: The credentials are missing or wrong.

403.description: The user may not call this endpoint.

429.description: The rate limit is exceeded. V5 sends no rate limit headers.

V5Error.description: The error body of a V5 call.

errorxid.description: The error ID to give Kentik support.

QueryRequest.description: The body of a top-X data or URL query.

queries.description: One item for each series. Usually one.

ChartRequest.description: The body of a top-X chart query.

queries.description: One item for each series. Usually one.

imageType.description: The image format: svg, png, jpg, or pdf.

QueryItem.description: One query and its series options. Keeps every field it gets, so JSON copied from Data Explorer reaches the API unchanged.

bucket.description: The series name. The response groups rows by it.

bucketIndex.description: The index of the query in its bucket, 0 or more.

isOverlay.description: Treats the query as an overlay. Chart and URL only.

Query.description: A query on the Kentik Data Engine. Types the fields that the Kentik Query API documentation lists, and keeps every other field it gets, so every V5 SDK field and JSON copied from Data Explorer reaches the API unchanged.

metric.description: The unit of measure, as a string or a list of strings (the V5 SDK sent a list): bytes, in_bytes, out_bytes, packets, in_packets, out_packets, tcp_retransmit, perc_retransmit, retransmits_in, perc_retransmits_in, out_of_order_in, perc_out_of_order_in, fragments, perc_fragments, client_latency, server_latency, appl_latency, fps, unique_src_ip, or unique_dst_ip.

dimension.description: The group-by dimensions, for example Proto, AS_src, IP_dst, Traffic, or a custom dimension.

device_name.description: The devices to query, as a comma-separated string or a list of names (the V5 SDK sent a list). Required in practice: the API returns 400 without it, even when all_selected is true.

device_labels.description: Device label IDs, as a list or a comma-separated string. Label names are not accepted.

lookback_seconds.description: The time range, in seconds back from now. Overrides starting_time and ending_time unless it is 0.

starting_time.description: The fixed start, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:00. Used when lookback_seconds is 0.

ending_time.description: The fixed end, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:00. Used when lookback_seconds is 0.

topx.description: The number of top rows that get time series, 1 to 40.

depth.description: The number of result rows from which topx is chosen, 25 to 250.

outsort.description: The aggregate name to sort by, for example avg_bits_per_sec.

fastData.description: The dataset: Auto, Fast, or Full.

hostname_lookup.description: Resolves IP addresses to host names. Set to false for faster IP queries.

cidr.description: The IPv4 prefix length for IP dimensions, 0 to 32.

cidr6.description: The IPv6 prefix length for IP dimensions, 0 to 128.

pps_threshold.description: The minimum packets per second for a flow to count.

aggregates.description: The aggregate columns. Kentik makes them from the metric when this is empty.

matrixBy.description: The matrix dimensions for a matrix chart.

minsPolling.description: The flow aggregation window in minutes: 1, 5, 10, or 20.

forceMinsPolling.description: Uses minsPolling instead of the automatic window.

reAggFn.description: The re-aggregation function: avg, max, min, or none.

viz_type.description: The chart type: stackedArea, line, stackedBar, bar, pie, sankey, table, or matrix. Chart and URL only.

show_overlay.description: Shows the historical overlay. Chart and URL only.

overlay_day.description: The number of days back for the overlay. Chart and URL only.

sync_axes.description: Syncs the left and right axis scales. Chart and URL only.

query_title.description: The title shown on the chart.

descriptor.description: The series label when queries has more than one item.

QueryFilters.description: The ad hoc filters of a query.

connector.description: How the filter groups combine: All (and) or Any (or).
How the filters combine: All (and) or Any (or).

not.description: Excludes the matching traffic instead of including it.

filterField.description: The KDE name of the dimension to filter on.

operator.description: The operator, for example =, <>, ILIKE, NOT ILIKE, ~, !~, >, <, or &.

is_not.description: Excludes the matching traffic instead of including it.

name.description: The column name, for example avg_bits_per_sec.

column.description: The KDE column to aggregate, for example f_sum_both_bytes.

fn.description: The function: sum, average, percentile, max, composite, exponent, modulus, greaterThan, greaterThanEquals, lessThan, lessThanEquals, equals, or notEquals.

rank.description: The percentile, 5 to 99, when fn is percentile.

sample_rate.description: A factor applied to every value.

TopXDataResponse.description: The result of a top-X data query.

bucket.description: The bucket name from the request.

data.description: One row per result. The keys depend on the query: the dimension columns, key, the aggregate columns, and timeSeries for the top-X rows.

ChartResponse.description: The result of a top-X chart query.
